sections.heading: FIRST DEGREE MURDER
sections.text: (1) Any person who directly causes a death of another person with premeditation and malicious intent; a death resulting of any armed robbery, assault with a deadly weapon, kidnapping, escape and rescue or attempted escape and rescue, or any other violent offense that poses a risk of death to the victim and such risk is disregarded, shall be guilty of First Degree Murder. (2) This shall be a Class A Offense.

sections.heading: SECOND DEGREE MURDER
sections.text: (1) Any person who directly causes a death of another person with malicious intent, lacking premeditation, shall be guilty of Second Degree Murder. (2) This shall be a Class B Offense.

sections.heading: MANSLAUGHTER
sections.text: (1) Any person who causes a death of another person with no premeditation or malicious intent, however still directly causes a death of another person as a result of criminal negligence. (2) This shall be a Class C Offense.

sections.heading: NEGLIGENT HOMICIDE
sections.text: (1) Any person who causes a death of another person with no premeditation or malicious intent, however still directly causing a death of another person as a result of gross negligence shall be guilty of Negligent homicide. (2) This shall be a Class D Offense.

sections.heading: INVOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER
sections.text: (1) Any person who kills another person as the result of a lawful act done with gross negligence with lack of care and awareness, shall be guilty of Involuntary manslaughter. (2) This shall be a Class D Offense.

sections.heading: VOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER
sections.text: (1) Any person who kills another person without intent to kill but as the result of reckless behaviour with disregard for the safety of themselves and others around them, shall be guilty of Voluntary manslaughter. (2) This shall be a Class C Offense.

sections.heading: ATTEMPTED MURDER
sections.text: (1) Any person who unsuccessfully attempts to, with malicious intent, end the life of another, shall be guilty of Attempted murder. (2) This shall be a Class C Offense.

sections.heading: AGGRAVATED ASSAULT
sections.text: (1) Any person who intends to inflict great bodily harm on another with a firearm or any equivalent deadly weapon or by any force or means likely to produce great bodily harm or death to another or; causes serious physical injury inflicted on a person by the deliberate action of another player or; rams a vehicle or aircraft into another player purposefully to trap or prohibit their movement, shall be guilty of assault. (2) This shall be a Class C Offense.

sections.heading: KIDNAPPING
sections.text: (1) Any person who uses fear, or force, to transport a person without their consent or legal authority to do so shall be guilty of kidnapping. (2) This shall be a Class D Offense.

sections.heading: PEACE ROBBERY
sections.text: (1) Any person who steals from a player, business recognized by the Department of Commerce and Labor or other institution recognized by legislation, utilizing fear or force to execute such offense without an object capable of causing severe harm to a player, shall be guilty of Peace robbery. (2) This shall be a Class E Offense.

sections.heading: ARMED ROBBERY
sections.text: (1) Any person who steals from a player, business recognized by the Department of Commerce and Labor or other institution recognized by legislation, utilizing an object capable of causing severe harm to a player and fear or force to execute such offense, shall be guilty of Armed robbery. (2) This shall be a Class D Offense.

sections.heading: TRAFFICKING
sections.text: (1) Any person who partakes in the malicious distribution of a player to another individual/group in exchange for any form of monetary, social, or political value shall be guilty of Trafficking. (2) This shall be a Class D Offense.

sections.heading: UNLAWFUL DISCHARGE OF A LETHAL FIREARM
sections.text: (1) Any person possessing a lethal firearm, whether it be automatic or manual, illegal or legal and discharging it without being attacked by another player, provocation or being in imminent danger, shall be guilty of illegally discharging a lethal firearm. (2) This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: SUICIDE
sections.text: (1) Any person who causes death by injuring oneself with the intent to die in the following two ways— (a) This shall include resetting to avoid arrest, detainment, inspection or citation; (b) This shall include attempting to jump, drive or remove oneself from the map causing them to respawn in an attempt to avoid arrest, detainment, inspection or citation; shall be guilty of Suicide. (2) This shall be a Class B Offense. (3) When violating this statute, the new life rule shall be bypassed and the subject may also face punishment for their crimes committed before violating this statute.
